integrity: Explicit query trees and terminal witnesses for sizes 1 through 7 are bundled. An independently coded verifier checks all paths against independently enumerated separable permutations, with no external datasets or third-party packages.
scientific_limitations: Exact Littlestone values are claimed only for 1 <= n <= 7. The all-size conclusion is a constructive lower bound along n divisible by 7, not an asymptotic exact formula. Priority under unindexed alternate terminology remains uncertain.
title: Entropy-tight adaptive comparisons in separable permutations through seven labels
